capabilities.justification: Package-local conformance tests decode the checked language-neutral graph, diff-selection, and repository-boundary fixtures; production source receives typed immutable values and performs no filesystem access.
Package-local conformance tests enumerate the closed fixture directory so a newly added graph or diff-selection case cannot be skipped silently; production source performs no directory access.

justification: The production graph and diff-selection core is process-free and has no host authority. Only the test adapter reads and lists the checked shared fixture corpus.
